fields.Name: Organizations with Staff & Active Member Count
fields.Description: One row per organization that employs at least one active staff member, for maps and regional views: organization name, street address, city, state/province, postal code, country, latitude/longitude, staff count, and how many of those staff are current members. Staff are active, open Employee relationships. A current member has a Confirmed annual membership purchase in the last 12 months that wasn't refunded (the same rule as the Membership Status query). Address and coordinates come from the organization's primary address, falling back to its More Cheese organization profile, so every organization has coordinates. A few have no street, postal code or country on file.
fields.TechnicalDescription:
## Overview

Identifies all organizations employing at least one staff member within the association database. For each organization, returns its name, complete primary address details (street address lines, city, state/province, postal code, and country), geocoded latitude and longitude coordinates, total staff count, and the count of staff members who hold an active association membership.

## Query Logic

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Organizations: [__mj_BizAppsCommon].vwOrganizations] -->|join active employees| B[Staff Relationships: [__mj_BizAppsCommon].vwRelationships]
    B -->|left join| C[Trailing 12-Month Qualifying Memberships]
    C -->|group by org, address & location| D[Calculate Staff & Active Member Counts]
    D -->|filter: at least 1 staff| E[Final Result Set: 576 Organizations]
```

## Data Sources

### MJ_BizApps_Common: Organizations (`[__mj_BizAppsCommon].vwOrganizations`)
- **ID** — Unique identifier for the organization (primary key)
- **Name** — Display name of the organization
- **PrimaryAddressLine1** — Street address line 1
- **PrimaryAddressLine2** — Street address line 2
- **PrimaryAddressCity** — City
- **PrimaryAddressState** — State or province
- **PrimaryAddressPostalCode** — Postal / ZIP code
- **PrimaryAddressCountry** — Country
- **PrimaryAddressLatitude** — Geocoded latitude coordinate of the organization's primary address
- **PrimaryAddressLongitude** — Geocoded longitude coordinate of the organization's primary address
- **__mj_Latitude** — Virtual geocoded latitude fallback
- **__mj_Longitude** — Virtual geocoded longitude fallback

### MJ_BizApps_Common: Relationships (`[__mj_BizAppsCommon].vwRelationships`)
- **ToOrganizationID** — Employer organization reference (foreign key)
- **FromPersonID** — Employee person reference (foreign key)
- **RelationshipType** — Filtered to `'Employee'` to identify staff
- **EndDate** — Filtered to `NULL` to identify active employment

### MJ_BizApps_Orders: Order Headers (`[__mj_BizAppsOrders].vwOrderHeaders`)
- **BillToPersonID** — Purchaser person ID matching the staff member
- **Status** — Filtered to `'Confirmed'`
- **OrderDate** — Filtered to trailing 12 months (`>= DATEADD(MONTH, -12, '2026-10-08')`)
- **ReversesOrderHeaderID** — Checked to exclude refunded orders

### MJ_BizApps_Orders: Order Lines (`[__mj_BizAppsOrders].vwOrderLines`)
- **OrderHeaderID** — Foreign key linking order line items to order headers
- **ProductID** — Foreign key referencing the catalog product

### MJ_BizApps_Orders: Products (`[__mj_BizAppsOrders].vwProducts`)
- **ID** — Primary key of the product
- **Name** — Filtered to annual membership products (`LIKE '% Membership (annual)'`)

## Relationships

```mermaid
erDiagram
    Organizations ||--o{ Relationships : "employs"
    Relationships }o--|| People : "staff person"
    People ||--o{ OrderHeaders : "purchases"
    OrderHeaders ||--o{ OrderLines : "contains"
    OrderLines }o--|| Products : "references"
    Organizations { uuid ID PK string Name string PrimaryAddressLine1 string PrimaryAddressCity string PrimaryAddressState string PrimaryAddressPostalCode string PrimaryAddressCountry decimal PrimaryAddressLatitude decimal PrimaryAddressLongitude }
    Relationships { uuid ID PK uuid ToOrganizationID FK uuid FromPersonID FK string RelationshipType date EndDate }
    OrderHeaders { uuid ID PK uuid BillToPersonID FK string Status datetime OrderDate }
    OrderLines { uuid ID PK uuid OrderHeaderID FK uuid ProductID FK }
    Products { uuid ID PK string Name }
```

## Filters & Conditions

- **Staff Relationship**: Employment link must be active (`RelationshipType = 'Employee'` AND `EndDate IS NULL`).
- **Staff Threshold**: Organization must have at least 1 staff member (`COUNT(DISTINCT r.FromPersonID) >= 1`).
- **Active Membership**: Defined as a Confirmed, non-refunded purchase of an annual membership product within the past 12 months.
- **Address & Coordinates**: Pulls primary physical address fields directly and uses `COALESCE(PrimaryAddressLatitude, __mj_Latitude)` and `COALESCE(PrimaryAddressLongitude, __mj_Longitude)` for spatial coordinates.
- **Ordering**: Sorted by `ActiveMemberCount DESC`, then `StaffCount DESC`, then `OrganizationName ASC`.
